content:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected for tenant=deltaops during a canary rollout of artifact v3.2.0-rc2 (sha=ab12cd34). Error: 502 gateway from runtime. Canary at 5%. Alerting oncall. link: https://dash.redwood.internal/incidents/1823456789

jordan (oncall): acked. oncall taking. i’m looking at runtime metrics and canary traffic routing now.

maya (sre): seeing a sharp spike in `runtime.response.5xx` for deltaops namespace around +30s after canary start. errors are 502/504 from grpc layer. example log: ```
level=error ts=2026-04-03T12:33:15Z tenant=deltaops req_id=xyz-123 msg="backend kv cache miss caused corrupt slice"
stack=runtime/kernel.go:452 runtime/kvcache.go:123
```

lee (eng-runtime): hmm, that log looks like a partial KV cache deserialization panic we've seen with quantized graphs when token cache gets malformed on heterogeneous nodes. can you confirm node labels for the canary?

jordan (oncall): canary nodes are in dedicated pool `deltaops-dedicated-1`, mixed machine types A100/RTX. pinned artifact hash = ab12cd34. previous stable pinned artifact for deltaops was v3.1.9 (sha=9f7e6b21).

emily (cs): looping in customer ops. @deltaops-ops are you seeing user impact? which endpoints?

deltaops-ops (customer): yes, several tenants report increased latency and intermittent failures on sheduler API and inference endpoints. traffic to our UI degraded. ~5% of requests failing from our end. canary started about 2m ago.

maya (sre): customer impact confirmed. recommended action: halt canary + pin back to last known-good artifact (v3.1.9). want to coordinate a pinned-artifact rollback rather than a full cluster rollback to minimize blast radius.

lee (eng-runtime): agree. quick plan: 1) pause canary traffic, 2) run `rdeploy pin --tenant deltaops --artifact v3.1.9 --reason "canary 502s"`, 3) verify health for 15m, 4) if good, resume and promote.

jordan (oncall): executing step 1: pausing canary routing to v3.2.0-rc2 now.

deploy-bot: Action acknowledged: pausing canary for tenant=deltaops. Traffic shifted back to pinned artifact v3.1.9 for existing requests; new canary allocations frozen. (runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/canary-pause)

jordan (oncall): executing pin command now: 
```
rdeploy pin --tenant deltaops --artifact v3.1.9 --sha 9f7e6b21 --by jordan --ticket INC-1423
```

deploy-bot: Pin operation started. Creating pin record and triggering tenant routing update.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: tenant=deltaops artifact=v3.1.9 sha=9f7e6b21. Rolling back canary allocations.

maya (sre): verifying metrics... initial 1m looks promising, error-rate dropping from ~12% to ~0.8% in last 90s. latency returning to baseline.

deltaops-ops (customer): we still see a few errors for in-flight sessions, but new requests look healthy. thanks.

lee (eng-runtime): quick post-mortem note: reproducer likely related to A100 node using optimized kernel that mishandled quantized cache edge-case; gc race on cache deserialization seen in logs. creating a draft issue: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/issues/4721

jordan (oncall): handoff — i need to step out in 20m. @maya can you take post-rollback monitoring and oncall for the next 2 hours? please verify no regression in other tenants.

maya (sre): will take. i'll keep 15m cadence checks and escalate if anything >1% errors or latency >2x p95.

emily (cs): i'll update DeltaOps CSM with mitigation details and ETA for a full patch. customer asks for a follow-up window. i'll propose a 24h timeline for a patch and invite them to the postmortem.

deltaops-ops (customer): appreciated. please confirm whether this affects our dedicated pool capacity or billing.

jordan (oncall): pinback shouldn't change capacity or billing. it's a routing change; your dedicated pool remains. cc: finance if needed.

deploy-bot: Incident update recorded: INC-1423 — deltaops canary pinback performed by jordan.

maya (sre): opening incident ticket with timeline and attaching logs + steps to reproduce. assigning to eng-runtime (lee) for root cause fix.

lee (eng-runtime): taking. I'll try to reproduce on a test rig that mirrors deltaops dedicated config. provisional fix: add stricter validation in kvcache deserializer and a fallback on parse error to avoid corrupt slices causing panic.

jordan (oncall): leaving notes for postmortem. thanks everyone for quick action. handing off to @maya. :thumbsup:

maya (sre): confirming handoff accepted. will ping if any drift. closing this thread once 2h stable window met. :white_check_mark:
